parole.significato: -ory; suffix attached to the supine stem of Latin verbs to form adjectives
parole.testo: Calque of Latin -ōrius (“-ory”) (itself from -ōr + -ius), using -or (from Latin -ōr) + -isch (from Proto-Germanic *-iskaz).

parole.significato: Batavian (member of the tribe of the Batavi)
parole.testo: From Latin Batavus, likely of Proto-Germanic origin; compare Batavia, Betuwe.
From Middle Dutch wandel (“Vandal”), from Latin Vandalus (“Vandal”), from Proto-Germanic *wandilaz. The spelling was readapted to the Latin.
